# Free Tools

> 1878 free tools that run in your browser. No sign-up, no uploads: what you enter stays on your device. Every tool has its own page with an explanation, usage steps and FAQ.

## Start

- [All tools](https://tools.sitefig.net/en/): all tools, searchable
- [About](https://tools.sitefig.net/en/about/)
- [Accessibility statement](https://tools.sitefig.net/en/accessibility/)
